DATED: 15/09/2023  u  IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  R/SPECIAL CRIMINAL APPLICATION NO. 6480 of 2019 ==========================================================
 SAJANBEN D/O DHANSINH PARMAR  Versus  STATE OF GUJARAT ==========================================================
Appearance:
ADITYA A CHOKSI(7835) for the Applicant(s) No. 1 MR P P MAJMUDAR(5284) for the Respondent(s) No. 2 MR HARDIK MEHTA, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1 ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP N. BHATT  Date : 15/09/2023  ORAL ORDER 1.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: By way of the present application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, the applicant prays for quashing and setting aside the impugned FIR being C.R.- I No.27 of 2019 registered with the Chhapi Police Station, District : Banaskantha for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 504, 506(2) and 114 of the IPC.
2. Respondent No.2 - complainant - Hansaben W/o.
Pravinsinh Amarsinh Rajput (Hadiyol) is present before the Court and admits the correctness and genuineness of the affidavit filed by her through her learned advocate.

Learned advocate Mr. Majmudar identifies respondent No.2 and confirms the correctness and genuineness of the affidavit filed NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/6480/2019 ORDER DATED: 15/09/2023 undefined by the complainant.
3. Rule.
Learned A.P.P. and learned advocate for the complainant waive service of notice of rule for respondent Nos.1 and 2, respectively.

Learned APP objects quashment of present proceedings on the Sajanben D/O Dhansinh Parmar vs State Of Gujarat on 15 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132592922/

sentences.text: premise of settlement.
4. With the consent of learned advocates, present application is taken up for final disposal today.
5. Learned advocate for the applicants has taken this Court through the factual matrix arising out of the present application.
6. At the outset, it is jointly submitted by the learned advocates for the respective parties that the parties have amicably resolved the dispute.

In support of such submission made at the bar by the learned advocates appearing for the respective parties, they have placed on record the affidavit of settlement of dispute duly signed by respondent No.2 - complainant.

7. Now, the dispute with reference to the impugned F.I.R. is settled and resolved by and between the parties, which is confirmed by the original complainant through her NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/6480/2019 ORDER DATED: 15/09/2023 undefined learned advocate, the trial would be futile and any further continuation of the proceedings would amount to abuse of process of law,
keeping in mind that the decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India has held this in case of Gian Singh versus State of Punjab reported in 2012 (10) SCC 303.

entities.text: Gian Singh versus State of Punjab reported in 2012 (10) SCC 303
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, the impugned F.I.R. is required to be quashed and set aside.
8. Resultantly, this application is allowed.

The impugned FIR being C.R.- I No.27 of 2019 registered with the Chhapi Police Station, District : Banaskantha and all other consequential proceedings arising out of said FIR are hereby quashed and set aside qua the applicant only.
9. Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
Direct service is permitted.

(SANDEEP N. BHATT,J) M.H. DAVE Sajanben D/O Dhansinh Parmar vs State Of Gujarat on 15 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132592922/
